title: PruneTopGODAGviz: Publication-Quality Pruned Gene Ontology DAG Visualisation
description: An R package and Shiny editor for transcript- or gene-level GO over-representation analysis, pruned GO DAGs, and publication-quality PDF/PNG/SVG/TIFF export. Includes compressed PANTHER annotation tables for Arabidopsis, maize, rice, soybean, human and mouse.
